instruction:
Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_04. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_04 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_04 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In SolidWorks, use sketch and feature tools to create a 100 mm x 45 mm x 8 mm lug plate with a rounded lug end radius of about 22.5 mm, one D18 pin bore at the lug end, and two D6 root mounting holes. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-LugBearing. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the lug plate. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-Bearing. Create sets named ROOT_HOLES and PIN_BORE, plus a surface named PIN_BORE_SURFACE. Use a coarse first-order linear solid mesh with modest local seeding on PIN_BORE only, using C3D8R where practical or coarse C3D4 where needed; do not use quadratic elements. Create a boundary condition named BC-RootHoles that constrains ROOT_HOLES. Create a load named Load-PinBearing that applies an approximately 2000 N bearing or coupling load on PIN_BORE_SURFACE. Submit the job named Job-LugBearing and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-LugBearing.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-LugBearing.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

 First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables. Software launch locations: SOLIDWORKS 2025: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\SOLIDWORKS 2025.lnk`; Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`.
